title: Minimum Difference
prompt:
**Description:** Given n integers, find the minimum absolute difference
between any two of them.

**Input:** Line 1: n (2 <= n <= 10^5). Line 2: n integers (|a_i| <= 10^9).
**Output:** One integer — the minimum difference.

**Example:** `4` / `10 -7 3 22` -> `7` (pair 3 and 10).

tests.name: sample
duplicates
negatives
two elements
tests.hint: The full long long range — int overflows.
